about: identity_test: for the round-2 updates of Goodfire's 67M Pile model and its VPD decomposition s-55ea3f9b (Gamma frozen, Delta fixed), are the subcomponents that carry the emoticon update still the same subcomponents? Filed before any identity measurement was run. Round 2 showed the pull-back (lr 1e-5) is faithful at steps 10 and 30 and the Euclidean lift is PGD-fragile (reports/analyses/2026-10-14_analysis_lift-test.md).

predictions.claim: The subcomponents that carry the pull-back's update are still the same subcomponents.
predictions.measure: state pullback_s30, its 20 selected subcomponents. A subcomponent keeps identity if r_self >= 0.9 AND rank == 1 AND write_cos >= floor_j - 0.1

predictions.claim: The pull-back's behavioural update is carried by a few subcomponents.
predictions.measure: state pullback_s30: reverting the 10 subcomponents with the largest revert-one drop together; fraction of gain removed = (log-odds(state) - log-odds(reverted)) / gain
predictions.prediction: fail (Adam spreads the update over all alive U, V; round 1 found 10 random subcomponents as good as the top 10)

reported_not_scored: the same measures for pullback_s10 and the three lift states (pull-back vs lift at matched norm)
whether 2359 or a sibling is among the 10 largest revert-one drops, and its change statistics
fraction removed for k in (1, 3, 10, 20, 30, 100, 300, 1000) and for all alive subcomponents

setup.bank: Pile val rows 512..543 (16 384 positions) plus the 73 held-out windows (2 993 positions)
setup.gamma_profile: reported only: |Pearson| of j's g over the Pile bank before vs after (upstream drift only, since Gamma reads raw activations), and |Pearson(g_j, |x . v_j|)| before and after
setup.null_group: for each selected subcomponent, one random alive subcomponent of the same matrix with |revert-one| below that matrix's median (seed 0): drift from upstream changes only
setup.read_signature: x . v over the bank, x the matrix's input under W0 (before, v) or the state (after, v2). r_self = |Pearson(after_j, before_j)|; rank of j among all alive before-profiles of the same matrix by |Pearson| with after_j; top-100 Jaccard by |x . v|
setup.revert_one: for every alive subcomponent j, the drop in held-out mean log-odds of `o` at the trigger position (73 windows, fp32) when j alone is reverted to its W0 value (u2 v2^T -> u v^T), weights otherwise at the state. gain = log-odds(state) - log-odds(W0)
setup.selected: the K_SEL = 20 subcomponents with the largest revert-one drop, per state

states.lift_s2, lift_s3, lift_s10: Euclidean lift (tol 1e-6) of the arm A W fine-tune rerun (lr 3e-5, seed 0) at steps 2, 3, 10, regenerated and checked against pullback.json. Steps 2 and 3 match pull-back steps 10 and 30 by max ||dW||/||W0|| (0.0053 vs 0.0051; 0.0065 vs 0.0066). Step 10 is where the lift's PGD ratio was 5.4
states.pullback_s10, pullback_s30: Adam on alive (U, V) offsets, lr 1e-5, arm A's loss, windows, batch, clip and seed (round 2 P3'), regenerated; held-out P(o) checked against pullback2.json

setup.write_signature: ablation effect: mean over j's top-64 Pile-bank positions (by |x . v| at W0) of log-softmax(full) - log-softmax(j ablated), a vocabulary vector; before at W0 with (u, v), after at the state with (u2, v2), same positions. write_cos = cosine(before, after). floor_j = cosine of the W0 effect over even-ranked vs odd-ranked positions (split half)
